{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Lost and Found Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Fits my heavy rock listening, but other albums here connect more closely with my current interests.

ItemID: NA; Title: Mezmerize Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Heavy riffs and unpredictable songwriting suit my recent interest in Ten Thousand Fists and 10.000 Days.
ItemID: NA; Title: Stone Sour Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The mix of melody and heaviness fits, but I am prioritizing more metal-focused picks today.
ItemID: NA; Title: The End of Heartache; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Melodic hooks alongside aggressive riffs feel like a strong next step from my In Flames listening.
ItemID: NA; Title: The War Within; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Its fast, riff-driven metal appeals to the side of my taste reflected in Advance And Vanquish.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Blessed Hellride; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its bluesier heavy rock direction is less appealing right now than melodic or progressive metal.
ItemID: NA; Title: Vol. 3: The Subliminal Verses; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The balance of aggression and memorable melodies fits what I want after Ten Thousand Fists.
ItemID: NA; Title: Damnation And A Day; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The symphonic heaviness connects with Death Cult Armageddon, but that is not my first priority today.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Oncoming Storm; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The melodic riffs and intensity appeal, but I would explore my selected metal albums before adding another."}
